items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: That's Bill, my mother's youngest brother. He's the only one left out of the family now. ... He just wants you to give a performance ... He keeps smorgas-bord ... to just make you happy at all times

ctx.x: Oh, William, Patrick, Patrick David, and Robert Walton, all Waltons. One of them is still living. He's my favorite uncle. I visit with him every week. That's Bill, my mother's youngest brother. He's the only one left out of the family now.
